description: Suggestion-chip content for the induction terminal's Page 7 (Finishing Details) and Page 8 (The Eight Questions). Every suggestion here is illustrative only -- a quick-start a player may click to insert into their own answer, never a real answer for any of the six actual kids. The Eight Questions' text is bible §20's real intake quiz, verbatim; do not alter the wording.
appearanceOptions: Never without their jacket, whatever the weather.
Looks like they just woke up, always.
Taller than they act like they are.
Dresses like someone twice their age.
You'd know them by their laugh before you'd know their face.

banalQuestions.text: What's the first thing you unpack, and the last?
suggestions: A photograph, first. Whatever's left, last.
Socks first — cold feet is a genuine tragedy.
Nothing's really unpacked. Still in the bag, just in case.

banalQuestions.text: What do you actually think of the canteen food?
suggestions: Better than home, and I'll never admit that.
I've had worse. I've also had much better.
Ask again after exam week.

banalQuestions.text: Who's the first person here whose name you bothered to learn?
suggestions: Whoever was rude to me first — you remember rude.
Nobody yet. Give it a week.
The kid who couldn't reach the top bunk. Felt obligated.

eightQuestions.text: Who do you love, and what would you never tell them?
suggestions: My little sister. That I'm scared too.
A friend back home. That I only left because of them.
Someone in this building already. That I noticed on day one.

eightQuestions.text: What are you good at that has nothing to do with piloting?
eightQuestions.purposeNote: This becomes your ground-role affinity, and probably a side plot.
suggestions: Fixing things nobody else can figure out.
Making people laugh when they need it.
Cooking — really cooking, not just canteen trays.

eightQuestions.text: What did you want to be, before the draft notice?
suggestions: A teacher. Still might be, someday.
Whatever my parents were, and I never said otherwise.
Honestly? Nothing. I hadn't decided yet.

eightQuestions.text: Who in this city owes you something? Who do you owe?
suggestions: Nobody owes me anything. I owe someone everything.
A friend covered for me once. I haven't paid that back.
Nobody yet — I've only just arrived.

eightQuestions.text: What is the smallest thing that would make today a good day?
eightQuestions.purposeNote: The campaign's cheapest, most reliable emotional lever — your GM will actually use this.
suggestions: A letter from home, any length.
Getting through a whole drill without being singled out.
Someone laughing at something I said on purpose.

eightQuestions.text: What do you not want the Directorate to know about you?
suggestions: Where I actually come from.
Why I really signed up.
Something I did before any of this.

eightQuestions.text: Name someone who thinks you are better than you are.
suggestions: My mother. She's wrong, but I let her be.
A teacher who wrote me a recommendation I didn't earn.
Someone I haven't spoken to in years.

eightQuestions.purposeNote: Tells your GM what register you want — funnier, darker, weirder. There's no wrong answer.
suggestions: People who take the uniform more seriously than the job.
My own bad luck, eventually — just not yet.
Anything that goes wrong for someone in charge.
